storage.restored: We brought back what you had filled in on this browser.
storage.full: Browser storage is full, so the most recent changes are not being saved. Export the JSON so nothing is lost.
storage.unavailable: Could not save on this browser (it may be a private window). Export the JSON to keep your resume.
error.email: That email looks incomplete. Check for the @ and the domain.
error.url: The address needs to start with https://
error.endBeforeStart: The end date comes before the start date.
error.tooLong: That text is too long to sit well on a resume.
form.identification.pronounsHint: e.g. she/her, he/him, they/them. Only appears if you want it to.
form.identification.linkHint: Paste the full address, starting with https://
form.summary.label: Professional summary
form.summary.hint: Three or four lines on who you are professionally and what you deliver. It sits at the top of the resume.
form.experience.bulletsHint: One sentence per line, starting with an action verb. Whenever you can, include a number: how much you saved, in what time, for how many people.
form.skill.name: Skill
form.skill.categoryHint: Optional, for grouping on the resume. e.g. Tools, Programming languages.
form.language.name: Language
form.language.levelHint: In your own words: basic, intermediate, advanced, fluent, native.
form.project.name: Project name
form.certification.name: Certification
review.exportHint: A file with everything you filled in, to keep or move to another computer.
review.importError: Could not read that file. It needs to be a JSON exported from here.
review.clearHint: Removes everything from this browser. This cannot be undone.
review.clearConfirm: Really delete? This cannot be undone.
review.privacy: Your resume is saved only in this browser. There is no server holding this data, and nobody but you has access to it.
styleGuide.title: Style guide
styleGuide.description: Every base component in each of its states, for visual review. Internal page, removed before launch.
demo.fullNameHint: Write it as it appears on your ID.
demo.summaryHint: Three or four lines at most.
demo.tooltip: Resumes that start each bullet with an action verb are read faster.
